text: The staff went out of their way to make us feel welcome from check-in to checkout. Rooms were immaculate and the bed was incredibly comfortable.
Decent location close to the main square, but the room was smaller than the photos suggested. Breakfast was a highlight though.
Noisy corridor all night and the air conditioning unit rattled constantly. Would not stay here again.
Absolutely stunning modern design throughout the hotel. The rooftop bar alone is worth the price.
A solid mid-range option with friendly staff. The decor is a bit dated but everything was clean and functional.
The price was steep for what we got — tiny bathroom, thin walls, and a view of a parking garage. Not worth it.
Great location right on the waterfront. Spacious rooms with lovely views — would definitely return.
The breakfast spread was impressive and the common areas were well maintained, but the room itself felt a little tired.
One of the best hotels I have ever stayed in. Flawless service, beautiful rooms, and the spa was exceptional.
The front desk was dismissive when I raised a maintenance issue and it took two days to fix a broken shower. Poor service overall.
Excellent value for the price. Clean, comfortable, and very conveniently located near public transport.
Quiet and peaceful hotel away from the tourist crowds. Rooms are spacious but the breakfast options are limited.
Found the room to be musty and not properly cleaned. The corridors smelled of cigarette smoke despite the no-smoking policy.
Wonderful boutique hotel with thoughtful decor and genuinely attentive staff. The homemade breakfast was a real treat.
Fair price and clean rooms, but the Wi-Fi was unreliable and the gym equipment was outdated.
Modern facilities and a great central location. The rooms are on the smaller side but very cleverly designed.
Overpriced compared to similar hotels nearby. The room was clean but nothing special for the rate we paid.
Stayed here for a week and felt completely at home. Staff remembered our names and preferences after the first day.
Good-value hotel in a quiet neighborhood. Rooms are spacious and the blackout curtains mean a great night's sleep.
Exceptional breakfast with local produce and the room had a stunning city view. Perfect base for exploring.
